prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1444; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the forces involved in a crash of this type. Presenting complaints centered on neck pain, restricted cervical range of motion, and headache consistent with whiplash-type injury. Examination findings and imaging studies clearly confirm the presence of soft tissue injury to the cervical region. The patient was seen for a total of eight visits, with care following a typical and expected course. Treatment intensity was reduced in step with clinical improvement, and the patient was discharged from active care once symptoms had substantially resolved. The patient has a prior history of treatment for the same body region within the past two years; that earlier condition contributes to some of the current complaints and has been considered in the overall assessment. Billing records reflect individual services rendered, with no repeated charges for the same services.
